Team —

Quick ask to tighten runway visibility ahead of finance lock next week. I attached the RDW_pipeline_runway_0607.xlsx and a short MAP for ClearSky (ClearSky_MAP_v2.pdf). Please do the following by EOD Wednesday, Jun 9 (PT):

- For every open opportunity > $50k in your book, update the Stage, Close Date (best estimate), and Commit Amount in the "Q3 Commit" column.
- Mark commit confidence (High/Med/Low) and a one-line blocker if any.
- If a deal should be removed from coverage this quarter, note the reason (procurement delay, budget, product fit).

Why: Finance will lock the forecast on Thu Jun 10 at 17:00 PT. I want a cleaned pipeline so we don't carry overstated coverage. This note focuses on deals with at-risk close dates inside the next 8 weeks.

Housekeeping: I copied Monica so she can reconcile any adjustments with forecast models. Link to the HubSpot deal is below for the ClearSky opp.

Good thread — I made a pass through my book this morning and added notes to the sheet. Top-line observations and suggested mitigation plays:

1) Net gap: after Lauren's adjustments, our top-of-funnel coverage for Q3 sits ~18% below target when counting only High/Med confidence commits. That aligns with weekly cadence.

2) Short plays to tighten coverage (pick 1–2 per owner):
   - Fast technical unblock (1–2 day engineer pairing): target 2 deals where POC is the blocker — reduces time-to-close by ~2 weeks.
   - Executive nudge + strict MSA signoff window: propose a 5% time-limited credit for deals that sign within 14 days of MSA receipt. Use sparingly (finance approved for up to three deals).
   - Re-classify Late-July closes that have low probability as "next-quarter" (we should not count them in June/early July runway).

3) ClearSky: Lauren's update looks right. If we keep $80k for Q3, we need an extra $250–300k in fast-follows to hit coverage target. I volunteered to run a quick outreach blitz to two net-new logos we're nurturing; will copy owners.

4) Ask to owners: if you haven't updated the Commit Confidence, mark High/Med/Low and add the blocker; Finance will treat Low as non-covered.

Quoting Lauren below for context.
